messages:
Maya Chen: Quick question — saw a proration / recognition oddity on ACME Corp's invoice. They paid annual reserved Dedicated capacity up front (invoice #ACME-23456) but our revenue schedule shows recognition starting in May and a lump some credited back in June. Can someone confirm the deferral schedule we applied?

Liam O'Rourke: Can you paste the invoice lines or billing export row? I can check schedule logic.

Maya Chen: Sure — pasted below (copied from billing export):

```
invoice_id: ACME-23456
invoice_date: 2025-05-06
payment_date: 2025-05-06
bill_item: Reserved Dedicated - annual commit
amount: 120000.00
service_start: 2025-05-15
service_end: 2026-05-15
billing_term: 12 months
recognition_rule: Prepay-Annual-Default
```

Maya Chen: Note the service_start is 2025-05-15 which is mid-month. Our deferral should prorate May and then recognize monthly starting June 1, but the GL shows a June lump recognized for the remaining balance.

Anita Patel: @Maya thanks — looks like the prepay handler used the calendar-month boundary rule instead of start-date-proration. That can happen if the subscription start date was entered as 2025-05-01 in the contract object but service_start in the invoice is 05-15.

Diego Rivera: Do we have the contract object for ACME? If the contract term was set 05/01 -> 04/30 then recognition will be aligned to month boundaries. If the invoice reflects a mid-month kickoff we should still prorate on first/last partial months unless there's an override.

Maya Chen: Contract ID ACME-CON-781 included a note to backdate to 05/01 for billing purposes, but Sales told us services actually started 05/15. Sounds like Sales backdated for invoicing.

Connor Blake: For revenue recognition: ASC 606 requires we recognize over the period services are provided. If services began 05/15 we need to debit Deferred Revenue and recognize pro rata for 05/15–05/31, then monthly thereafter. The lump in June looks like the system applied full-month recognition for May and then adjusted June.

BillingBot: Payment posted for ACME-23456 — amount $120,000.00 — method: wire — processed 2025-05-06.

Sarah Kim: Can we get the journal entry that was generated? If the deferral schedule ran with start=05/01 then the JE would have recognized 1/12 in May incorrectly.

Liam O'Rourke: Pulling the JE now.

Liam O'Rourke: JE for ACME-23456:
```
2025-05-06  Credit Cash $120,000
            Debit Deferred Revenue $120,000
2025-06-01  Debit Deferred Revenue $119,000
            Credit Revenue $119,000
2025-05-31  Debit Deferred Revenue $1000
            Credit Revenue $1000
```

Liam O'Rourke: Those numbers are illustrative — actual distribution in GL shows a big credit 06/01 and a small 05/31. Need to confirm calculation.

Anita Patel: That pattern implies the scheduler treated May as full month for recognition and then moved the remaining 11 months starting June. Should have been May half-month (~$4,032) then 11 equal months of remainder.

Maya Chen: Action items I propose: 1) Reverse mistaken recognition JE for June, 2) create correct deferral schedule prorating May 15–31, 3) post adjusting entries and notify audit. Agree? @Connor @Diego

Connor Blake: Agree. Will prepare reversal and adjusting JE. Need GL account numbers and approval from Head of Finance.

Diego Rivera: I'll confirm contract vs invoice authoritative date. If Sales intentionally backdated, we need formal documentation to justify different recognition. Please attach the signed amendment if exists.

Maya Chen: Attaching the Sales note here: "Sales confirmed billing start 05/01 for invoicing only; services start 05/15." (pasted in thread).

Sarah Kim: Without a signed amendment, auditors will require recognition per actual service start. Please flag this as a potential audit adjustment.

Anita Patel: I'll draft the reversing JE and corrected schedule. Connor, once you post the reversal I can post the recognition entries.

Connor Blake: ETA 2 business days. I'll include a memo referencing ACME-23456 and link to the adjusted deferral schedule.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. Quick note — can we also add a guard in billing pipeline to prefer invoice.service_start over contract.billing_start when they differ by >7 days? Might prevent this class of error. @Liam thoughts?

Liam O'Rourke: Good idea. We can add a validation check and a warning flag on invoice generation. I'll file an eng ticket and cc @eng-billing.

Diego Rivera: :thumbsup: — please include the audit note so we don't miss trailing entries.

Maya Chen: I'll follow up with Sales to get formal amendment if they have one. Marking this thread for month-end close FYI. :warning:

Anita Patel: Added to month-end adjustments tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/FAKE_LINK (ACME-23456 row).

Connor Blake: Posted reversal JE and attached support docs in NetSuite. Leaving this thread open until audit signs off.

Maya Chen: Closing loop — thanks all, will ping if Sales provides amendment.
